productGoal: Test-only, on-device live speech-to-text for meetings with fast provisional words and reliably corrected final sentences; never enable by default.
dependency: Complete native-feel typing repairs and Swipe Typing acceptance before implementing live ASR.
principle: Immediate recording and UI feedback; provisional recognition may lag and revise; text must never pretend to be final until a verified segment completes.

architecture.audio: Existing AVAudioEngine audio tap and session bridge. Do not run duplicate taps; preserve standard recording mode.
architecture.segments: Propose 2–4 second speech chunks plus 300–700ms overlap, gated by VAD and acoustic continuity; parameters to benchmark.
architecture.model: Evaluate current Qwen3 ASR ONNX against chunked incremental calls; native streaming API not verified. Keep existing batch finalization intact.
architecture.transcript: Maintain provisional and committed spans with timestamps, atomic file changes and one clearly marked tentative region.
architecture.feedback: Visible recording consent and explicit stop/cancel, tiny latency status, no network or invisible background listening.
architecture.meetingFeatures: Test-only timeline with text and timestamps; diarization and summaries are future research, not promised.
architecture.privacy: On-device first; do not upload speech; configurable retention, clear-on-cancel, user-initiated session.
architecture.performance: Benchmark cold/warm latency, 5/20/60 minute sessions, memory pressure, battery and thermal throttling on iPhone 17 Pro Max.

phases.task: Record real Cantonese colloquial/code-switch corpus and user-approved spellings
Evaluate model chunking/VAD and rolling stable-text quality
phases.acceptance: No duplicate or lost words at chunk boundaries

phases.task: Add hidden experimental switch in a later isolated branch
Measure meeting-use reliability, privacy and battery
phases.acceptance: Explicit approval before any default exposure
